claims.statement: Runtime model traffic is routed through the local OmniRoute-compatible endpoint.

evidence.assertion: seven model calls were attributed to OmniRoute

claims.note: Observed in the accepted reference run; this does not prove every future deployment configuration.

claims.statement: Preflight discovers the live catalog and records the selected route and provider evidence.
claims.note: Proven for the accepted run against the reachable gateway recorded in the metrics artifact.

claims.statement: The finite route ladder reports infrastructure blockers instead of disguising failure as product success.

evidence.assertion: benchmark status and blocker fields are persisted
provider failure classification and fallback behavior

claims.note: The accepted run proves the reporting boundary; provider failure variants remain unit-tested rather than production-proven.

claims.statement: Structured Chief Engineer calls use a bounded configurable timeout.

evidence.assertion: timeout setting is explicit and bounded

claims.note: The configuration contract is proven; a long-running production timeout scenario is not part of the accepted reference run.

claims.statement: The PRD-to-PR pipeline reaches bounded agent turns, tests, repair/review, artifacts, and PR_READY.

evidence.assertion: five imported tasks reached PR_READY and the run completed

claims.note: Proven by the accepted ForgeLedger reference execution.

claims.statement: Task contracts constrain files, APIs, tests, dependencies, risk, and required release evidence.

evidence.assertion: reference report links task artifacts and acceptance evidence
PR evidence and contract behavior are tested

claims.note: The contract path is observed in the reference run; arbitrary production-scale task shapes are not covered yet.

claims.statement: The shared Harness provides typed methods, bounded strategies, context compaction, schema validation, retries, spans, and tool hooks.
claims.note: Proven for the reference probe and source contract; broad workload coverage remains future work.

claims.statement: Harness state and subagent lifecycles persist with parentage, bounds, snapshots, and terminal protection.
claims.note: Reference probes prove the bounded lifecycle, not Pod restart recovery.

claims.statement: Goals, todos, claims, leases, receipts, quotas, signals, and review projections are durable and authoritative.

evidence.assertion: control plane completed with five receipts and ten revisions
goal, todos, receipts, events, and idempotency keys persisted

claims.note: The reference run proves local durable execution; Kubernetes restart and multi-tenant isolation are not proven.

claims.statement: Built-in and user-created skills are declarative, bounded, selected from task context, and safety-gated.

evidence.assertion: skills conformance passed for built-ins and a persisted custom manifest

claims.note: Proven for the reference skill path; no claim is made about a large community catalog.

claims.statement: ActionGateway and Safety Kernel enforce role, path, command, network, Git, protected-file, and human-approval boundaries.

evidence.assertion: safety_hooks conformance denied a tool before execution
safety policy and protected action tests

claims.note: The accepted run proves a denial boundary; the complete human approval journey remains a plan item.

claims.statement: Graphify, MemPalace, RuleSynthesizer, and OpenTelemetry timeline events provide local evidence and memory boundaries.

evidence.assertion: nested span and lifecycle event model

claims.note: Proven for local fixtures and reference spans; long-running production telemetry is not proven.

claims.statement: Context7 MCP is an available optional integration surface for current documentation.

evidence.assertion: reproducible live probe without printing credentials
authentication, session, fallback, and audit integration tests

claims.note: The current reference benchmark intentionally does not require Context7; this is not a benchmark-wide LIVE claim.

claims.statement: Redis cache, pub/sub, and lock primitives are available as an optional integration surface.
claims.note: No live Redis server, lock race, pub/sub, or restart evidence is present in the accepted reference run.

claims.statement: Helm templates and autoscaling are available as an optional deployment surface.
claims.note: The reference run checks only surface presence; helm lint, install, readiness failure, and rollback remain unproven.

claims.statement: The frontend exposes mission, task, agent, skill, memory, safety, review, and timeline surfaces.
claims.note: Source presence is proven; reproducible build, browser behavior, accessibility, and hosted deployment are not.

claims.statement: A frontend build or hosted deployment is a separate release gate.

evidence.assertion: README explicitly separates the frontend release gate

claims.note: The repository does not yet contain accepted build, browser, and hosted evidence for the full Mission Control journey.

claims.statement: Reference repositories are not runtime dependencies and source code is not copied into ForgeOS.
claims.note: Static dependency and documentation evidence exists; a separate release audit should repeat this check.

claims.statement: Human review remains required before merge, deploy, publication, or irreversible external action.
claims.note: The control boundary exists, but the full deny/expire/approve UI/API journey is a later plan task.
